name: What is the typical process for exterior stucco repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for exterior stucco repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical stucco repair process begins with a thorough inspection to assess the extent and cause of the damage. Damaged stucco is carefully removed, and the underlying substrate is prepared. A new base coat is applied, often with a mesh for reinforcement, followed by a finish coat. The new stucco is then textured and colored to match the existing finish as closely as possible, ensuring a seamless repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair involves inspecting damage, removing old material, preparing the surface, and applying new base and finish coats to match existing stucco.
